description: This file defines keyboard key codes, key mappings, and utility functions for handling keyboard events, including layout-specific key matching and modifier key checks, used in the Excalidraw project.

methods.name: isLatinChar
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a Latin lowercase character.

methods.name: matchKey
methods.description: Determines if a keyboard event matches a specified key, considering different keyboard layouts and fallback to event code.

methods.name: isArrowKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is an arrow key.

methods.name: shouldResizeFromCenter
methods.description: Checks if the Alt key is pressed to determine resize behavior.

methods.name: shouldMaintainAspectRatio
methods.description: Checks if the Shift key is pressed to maintain aspect ratio.

methods.name: shouldRotateWithDiscreteAngle
methods.description: Checks if the Shift key is pressed to rotate with discrete angles.
